metadata.title: Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow mixed with big tech earnings on deck - MarketWatch

content.text:
Updated 26 min ago
Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow mixed with big tech earnings on deck
The Nasdaq Composite Index was leading the selloff early Wednesday, as the S&P 500 and Dow opened mixed ahead of Alphabet and Tesla earnings.
The Nasdaq opened about 130 points lower, or 0.5%, near 25,706.
The S&P 500 was off 0.2%.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 0.1%.
There was a cautious tone on Wall Street early Wednesday as the major "hyperscalers" start reporting quarterly results and the U.S. and Iran escalate hostilities in the Middle East.
